import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import io

# Load the dataset from the string
csv_data = """Person ID,Gender,Age,Occupation,Sleep Duration,Quality of Sleep,Physical Activity Level,Stress Level,BMI Category,Blood Pressure,Heart Rate,Daily Steps,Sleep Disorder
1,Male,27,Software Engineer,6.1,6,42,6,Overweight,126/83,77,4200,
2,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
3,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
4,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
5,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
"""

df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(csv_data))

# --- Data Preprocessing ---
# Fill missing Sleep Disorder values with 'None'
df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None', inplace=True)

# Split Blood Pressure into Systolic and Diastolic columns
df[['Systolic', 'Diastolic']] = df['Blood Pressure'].str.split('/', expand=True).astype(int)

# Define a clear color palette for Sleep Disorders
disorder_palette = {'None': '#3498db', 'Sleep Apnea': '#e74c3c', 'Insomnia': '#9b59b6'}

# Set the theme for the plots
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", palette="viridis")

# --- Visualization ---
# Create a 2x2 grid of subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Analysis of Sleep Health and Lifestyle Factors', fontsize=20, weight='bold')

# Plot 1: Sleep Duration vs. Stress Level
sns.scatterplot(
    ax=axes[0, 0],
    data=df,
    x='Stress Level',
    y='Sleep Duration',
    hue='Sleep Disorder',
    size='Physical Activity Level',
    sizes=(50, 250),
    palette=disorder_palette,
    edgecolor='black',
    alpha=0.8
)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Sleep Duration vs. Stress Level', fontsize=14, weight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].legend(title='Sleep Disorder & Activity')

# Plot 2: Quality of Sleep by Occupation
sns.boxplot(
    ax=axes[0, 1],
    data=df,
    x='Quality of Sleep',
    y='Occupation',
    palette='magma',
    orient='h'
)
sns.stripplot(
    ax=axes[0, 1],
    data=df,
    x='Quality of Sleep',
    y='Occupation',
    color=".25",
    size=6,
    jitter=0.1
)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Distribution of Sleep Quality by Occupation', fontsize=14, weight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Occupation', fontsize=12)

# Plot 3: Health Metrics by BMI Category
# Use a categorical order for BMI
bmi_order = ['Normal', 'Overweight', 'Obese']
df['BMI Category'] = pd.Categorical(df['BMI Category'], categories=bmi_order, ordered=True)

sns.violinplot(
    ax=axes[1, 0],
    data=df,
    x='BMI Category',
    y='Heart Rate',
    hue='BMI Category',
    palette='crest',
    inner='quartile',
    legend=False
)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Heart Rate Distribution by BMI Category', fontsize=14, weight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Resting Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=12)

# Plot 4: Daily Steps vs. Systolic Blood Pressure
sns.regplot(
    ax=axes[1, 1],
    data=df,
    x='Daily Steps',
    y='Systolic',
    scatter_kws={'s': 100, 'alpha': 0.7, 'edgecolor': 'w'},
    line_kws={'color': '#e74c3c', 'linewidth': 2.5}
)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Daily Steps vs. Systolic Blood Pressure', fontsize=14, weight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Systolic Blood Pressure (mmHg)', fontsize=12)

# Adjust layout and save the figure
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.03, 1, 0.95])
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300)
